summary.text: Brian Maher is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 101 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Maher lives in Montgomery, New York, and earned a degree in political science from Brooklyn College.
His career experience includes working as an executive director with the National Purple Heart Hall of Honor, Inc., and as director of communications for state Sen. Bill Larkin.
Maher assumed office on January 1, 2023, succeeding Brian Miller.
